title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on $20B in U.S. goods take effect
description: Canada's steep retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion in U.S. goods took effect just after midnight ET on Tuesday, extending the trade war between the two countries.

title: Canada Imposes New Tariffs on U.S. Goods, as Trade War Intensifies
description: The duties are a retaliation against President Trump’s recent tariffs, raising concerns about further escalation.

title: Flash floods fill the streets of a neighbourhood in central Morocco
